list.intro: Orders your customers place, from the day they order to the day you deliver. Each counts as a sale when it's delivered.
list.intro_food: Cake and catering orders from WhatsApp, Instagram or the phone, with delivery and deposits. Each counts as a sale on the day you deliver it.
list.intro_maker: Custom orders with their deposits, from the day they're placed to the day you deliver. Each counts as a sale when it's delivered.
list.intro_workshop: Your customers' orders, from the deposit to the delivery. Each counts as a sale on the day you deliver it.
list.intro_factory: Customers' orders with their LPO numbers, often on credit. Each counts as a sale on the day you deliver it.
list.intro_retail: Orders customers place for items to pick up or have delivered. Each counts as a sale when it's delivered.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by order number or customer
list.searchPlaceholder_factory: Search by order number, LPO or customer
list.searchPlaceholder_retail: Search by order number or customer
list.searchPlaceholder_workshop: Search by order number, LPO or customer

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Enter an order when a customer places it: what they want, when it's due, and any deposit. Deliver it when it's ready.
empty.body_food: Enter a cake or catering order as soon as it comes in: what they want, when it's due, delivery and the deposit. Deliver it on the day.
empty.body_factory: Enter a customer's order with their LPO number: what they want and when it's due. Deliver it when it's ready.
empty.body_retail: Enter an order when a customer places it: the items, when it's due, and any deposit. Deliver it when it's ready.
empty.viewer: Orders show here once your team enters them.

editor.intro: What the customer ordered and when it's due. Nothing counts in your sales until you deliver it.
editor.intro_factory: The customer's LPO, what they ordered and when it's due. Nothing counts in your sales until you deliver it.
editor.intro_retail: The items the customer ordered and when they're due. Nothing counts in your sales until you deliver them.
editor.customerKept: This order has payments, so it keeps its customer.
editor.customerRefHint: Optional. Their own order number, if they gave one.
editor.customerRefHint_factory: The number on their purchase order (LPO), so they recognise it later.
editor.customerRefHint_retail: Optional. Their own order number, if they gave one.
editor.addDiscount: Add a discount on the whole order
editor.paidNowHint: A deposit or the whole amount the customer paid when ordering. Later payments go on the order's page.
editor.notesHint: Anything to remember for this order (optional)
editor.notesHint_food: For example, the writing on the cake or an allergy (optional)
editor.notesHint_retail: Anything to remember for this order (optional)

errors.dueBefore: The due date can't be before the order date.
errors.discountOver100: A discount can't be more than 100%.
errors.discountOverItems: The discount is more than the items come to.
errors.discountMixed: Some items' prices include VAT and others don't, so the whole-order discount must be a percentage.
errors.depositOverTotal: The deposit can't be more than the order's total.

view.title: Order {{number}}
view.deliveredNote: Delivered on {{date}}: it adds {{amount}} to your sales.
view.cancelledNote: This order was cancelled. Nothing in your sales changed.
view.cancelledPayments: A deposit on a cancelled order is money back to the customer until you record giving it back.
view.late: This order is late: it was due on {{date}}.
view.costsHidden: Costs and profit are hidden: your role doesn't show costs.
view.notFoundBody: It may not exist, or it isn't one you can see.

confirm.deliverBody: This counts as a sale on {{date}}: {{amount}}.
confirm.deliverBodyVatChanged: This counts as a sale on {{date}}. Your VAT registration changed since the order was saved, so its amounts are worked out again.
confirm.deliverNote: What it used is costed as of that day. If something is wrong later, you can undo the delivery.
confirm.deliverNoteVatChanged: If the customer already paid more than the new total, the difference shows as money to give back. If something is wrong later, you can undo the delivery.
confirm.deliverBeforeOrder: The delivery can't be before the order date.
confirm.delivered: Order {{number}} delivered. It now counts in your sales.
confirm.closedToday: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be delivered today. You can deliver it from tomorrow, or once the books are open again in Settings.
confirm.booksClosed: The books are closed on that day. Choose a later day.
confirm.cancelBody: It stays in your list, marked cancelled. Nothing in your sales changes.
confirm.cancelNote: A cancelled order can't be changed or delivered again.
confirm.cancelPaid: The customer paid {{amount}} on it: it shows as money to give back until you record giving it back.
confirm.undoBody: Its sale of {{date}} is reversed and the order waits again. Its payments stay on it.
confirm.undoNote: You can deliver it again later.
confirm.undoRefunds: This order has refunds. Reverse them first, from their sales.
confirm.undoClosed: The books are closed for its delivery day, so the delivery can't be undone.
confirm.undone: Delivery undone. Order {{number}} is waiting again.

profit.title: What this order earned
profit.hint: Its sale and refunds, as your real profit counts them.
profit.incomplete: Not complete yet: some costs are missing, so the real profit is lower than this.
profit.beforeRunning: Before running costs: its share isn't counted yet.

files.title: Files
files.hint: A photo of the order or a file the customer sent, up to 10 MB.
files.hint_workshop: The customer's LPO or a drawing, as a photo or PDF up to 10 MB.
files.hint_factory: The customer's LPO, as a photo or PDF up to 10 MB.
files.hint_retail: A photo of the order or a file the customer sent, up to 10 MB.
files.afterSave: You can attach the customer's LPO or a photo once the order is saved.
files.removeBody: The file is deleted. The order stays as it is.

payLater.label: They'll pay later
payLater.hint: The customer owes what it comes to until they pay. You record their payments under What customers owe.
payLater.needsCustomer: First pick the customer who will pay.

sale.fromOrderNote: This sale is an order's delivery. To take it back, undo the delivery on the order; to refund it, use the order.
sale.reverseRefundsFirst: To reverse this sale, reverse its refunds first.
sale.deliveryCostOnOrder: The order's delivery was undone: enter what the delivery cost on the order.

refund.title: Refund

byHint.quantity: What comes back comes off your sales, and so does what it cost.
byHint.amount: Only the price comes off your sales: what the items cost stays.

refund.nothingLeft: Nothing is left to refund on it.
refund.giveBackHint: The customer paid {{amount}} more than the order then comes to.
refund.paidWhenMade: Give the money back the way the customer paid: it isn't recorded here.
refund.notesHint: Optional. For example, a damaged item or a wrong price.

errors.beforeSale: The refund can't be before the sale.
errors.booksClosed: The books are closed on this day. Choose a later day.
errors.exceedsLeft: That's more than is left of it.
errors.nothing: Type what's taken back on at least one line.

payment.title: Record a payment
payment.description: What the customer paid on {{document}}. Part of it is fine.
payment.moneyBackDescription: Money you gave back to the customer on {{document}}.
payment.amountHintBack: Up to {{amount}}, what they paid beyond what it comes to.
payment.noteHint: Optional. For example, the cheque number.
payment.beforeOrder: This day is before the order. Choose its day or a later one.
payment.beforeSale: This day is before the sale. Choose its day or a later one.
payment.overMoneyBack: That's more than the customer paid beyond what it comes to.

payments.title: Payments
payments.overpaidNote: The customer paid {{amount}} more than it comes to: give it back, then record it here.
payments.depositGivenBack: The deposit was given back. Nothing is owed.
payments.reversedOn: Reversed on {{date}} by {{name}}. It no longer counts.
payments.reversedOnAlone: Reversed on {{date}}. It no longer counts.
payments.reverseBody: {{amount}} is owed again. The payment stays listed, marked reversed.
payments.reverseBackBody: {{amount}} shows as money to give back again. It stays listed, marked reversed.
payments.reverseNote: Use this for a payment recorded by mistake.
payments.reverseClosed: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be reversed today. You can reverse it from tomorrow, or once the books are open again in Settings.

payMany.title: Record a payment
payMany.description: What {{name}} paid. It goes to their oldest orders and sales first.
payMany.descriptionSales: What {{name}} paid. It goes to their oldest sales first.
payMany.amountHint: One amount: it pays them in the order shown, each up to what it owes.
payMany.nothingChosen: Choose at least one order or sale.
payMany.beforeDocument: This day is before one of these orders or sales. Choose a later day.
payMany.beforeDocumentSales: This day is before one of these sales. Choose a later day.
payMany.overOwed: That's more than they owe on these.
payMany.recorded_one: Payment recorded on {{count}} order or sale.
payMany.recorded_other: Payment recorded on {{count}} orders and sales.

receivables.intro: What each customer still owes on their orders and on sales they pay later, oldest first. Record a payment, or one payment over several at once.
receivables.intro_factory: What each customer still owes on their orders and monthly accounts, oldest first. Record a payment, or one payment over several at once.
receivables.intro_retail: What each customer still owes on their orders and on sales they pay later, oldest first. Record a payment, or one payment over several at once.
receivables.introSales: What each customer still owes on sales they pay later, oldest first. Record a payment, or one payment over several at once.

empty.title: Nobody owes you anything
empty.body: Orders with a deposit or not paid yet, and sales they pay later, show here until they're paid.
empty.bodySales: Sales they pay later show here until they're paid.

customers.intro: The people and companies you sell to. Names may repeat: the phone tells two apart.
customers.intro_food: The people who order from you. Names may repeat: the phone tells two apart.
customers.intro_factory: The companies and government bodies you supply, with their TRN for invoices.
customers.intro_retail: The people and companies you sell to. Names may repeat: the phone tells two apart.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.body: Add a customer here, or right from an order or a sale.
empty.bodySales: Add a customer here, or right from a sale.
empty.body_food: Add the people who order from you here, or right from an order.
empty.viewer: Customers show here once your team adds them.

form.newDescription: Their name, and a phone if you have it: it tells two customers of the same name apart.
form.nameHint: As you call them, in any language.
form.phoneHint: Optional. It tells customers of the same name apart.
form.phoneInvalid: Use digits, spaces, +, - or brackets only.
form.emailInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address.
form.trnHint: Optional. Their 15-digit Tax Registration Number, for tax invoices.
form.licenceHint: Optional. For invoices to a business or a government body.
form.notesHint: Optional. For you and your team.

similar.title: Did you mean…?
similar.body: You already have a customer with this name or one like it. Names can repeat, so add a new one only if it's someone else.
similar.bodyPick: You already have a customer with this name or one like it. Pick them, or add a new one if it's someone else.

picker.label: Customer
picker.placeholder: Type a name to find or add
picker.none: No customers yet. Type a name to add one.
picker.saleHint: Optional. Needed when they'll pay later.

page.notFoundBody: It may not exist, or it isn't one you can see.
